For dessert you have to try their authentic Brazilian sweet pizza topped with bananas, strawberries, and chocolate sauce. A surprising treat. Review by - Google five star review by Keely M: Best pizza in west portal, maybe even in San Francisco! A neighborhood classic that never disappoints and is always reliable. We've been ordering take out for years but have recently been lucky enough to dine in house. The staff is spectacular and so kind, they make you feel like family. An establishment for all occasions and a must visit in west portal! We love you guys! (Also so vegan friendly) Review by - Google five star review by Maria M: We love ordering delivery from Mozzarella and occasionally eat at the restaurant.
